sessionStart.powershell: $ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $h='http://127.0.0.1:5244/health'; try { if((Invoke-WebRequest $h -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 2).StatusCode -eq 200){ exit 0 } } catch {}; $exe=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'narnia\app\NexusLabs.Narnia.Web.exe'; if(Test-Path $exe){ Start-Process -FilePath $exe -ArgumentList '--urls','http://127.0.0.1:5244' -WindowStyle Hidden; for($i=0;$i -lt 12;$i++){ Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 800; try { if((Invoke-WebRequest $h -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 2).StatusCode -eq 200){ break } } catch {} } }; exit 0
sessionStart.bash: curl -sf --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:5244/health >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; D="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/narnia/app"; [ "$(uname)" = "Darwin" ] && D="$HOME/Library/Application Support/narnia/app"; if [ -f "$D/NexusLabs.Narnia.Web.dll" ]; then nohup dotnet "$D/NexusLabs.Narnia.Web.dll" --urls http://127.0.0.1:5244 >/dev/null 2>&1 & for i in $(seq 1 12); do sleep 1; curl -sf --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:5244/health >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; done; fi; exit 0
